mapper.select: SELECT A.WORK_HSTRY_SN ,A.USER_ID ,A.WORK_YMD ,DATE_FORMAT(A.GTWK_DT, '%H:%i') AS GTWK_DT ,DATE_FORMAT(A.LVWK_DT, '%H:%i') AS LVWK_DT ,A.POWK_SE_CD ,IFNULL(POWK_CD.CD_NM, A.POWK_SE_CD) AS POWK_SE_NM ,A.WORK_RMRK_CN ,A.REG_DT ,A.MDFCN_DT /* 근무 분 계산: 퇴근기록 없으면 현재시각과 비교 */ ,CASE WHEN A.LVWK_DT IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, A.GTWK_DT, A.LVWK_DT) AS CHAR) WHEN A.GTWK_DT IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, A.GTWK_DT, NOW()) AS CHAR) ELSE '0' END AS WORK_MINUTES FROM WORK_HSTRY A LEFT JOIN cmn_cd POWK_CD ON POWK_CD.CD_GROUP_ID = 'POWK_SE_CD' AND POWK_CD.CD = A.POWK_SE_CD AND POWK_CD.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.WORK_YMD = CURDATE() LIMIT 1

SELECT S.SCHDL_SE_CD AS STATUS_CD, IFNULL(C.CD_NM, S.SCHDL_SE_CD) AS STATUS_NM, 'Y' AS SCHEDULE_LINKED_YN, S.SCHDL_NM FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'CAL_SCHDL_SE_CD' AND C.CD = S.SCHDL_SE_CD WHERE S.CO_ID = #{coId} AND R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.SCHDL_SE_CD IN ('VAC', 'BIZTRIP', 'OUTSIDE', 'HOME', 'CLIENT') AND NOW() BETWEEN S.BGNG_DT AND S.END_DT ORDER BY FIELD(S.SCHDL_SE_CD, 'VAC', 'BIZTRIP', 'OUTSIDE', 'HOME', 'CLIENT'), S.BGNG_DT LIMIT 1
SELECT C.CD AS POWK_SE_CD, C.CD_NM AS STATUS_NM FROM cmn_cd C WHERE C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'POWK_SE_CD' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ, C.CD

WITH RECURSIVE dept_ancestor AS ( SELECT D.DEPT_ID, D.UP_DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_SE_CD, 0 AS DEPTH FROM dept_info D WHERE D.CO_ID = #{coId} AND D.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT P.DEPT_ID, P.UP_DEPT_ID, P.DEPT_SE_CD, A.DEPTH + 1 FROM dept_info P JOIN dept_ancestor A ON A.UP_DEPT_ID = P.DEPT_ID WHERE P.CO_ID = #{coId} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEPTH < 10 ), scope_root AS ( SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT A.DEPT_ID FROM dept_ancestor A WHERE A.DEPT_SE_CD = 'HQ' ORDER BY A.DEPTH DESC LIMIT 1), #{deptId} ) AS DEPT_ID ), dept_scope AS ( SELECT D.DEPT_ID FROM dept_info D JOIN scope_root R ON R.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID WHERE D.CO_ID = #{coId} AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION SELECT C.DEPT_ID FROM dept_info C JOIN dept_scope P ON C.UP_DEPT_ID = P.DEPT_ID WHERE C.CO_ID = #{coId} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SELECT T.USER_ID, T.USER_NM, T.CO_ID, T.DEPT_ID, T.DEPT_NM, T.JBPS_NM, T.STATUS_CD, CASE T.STATUS_CD WHEN 'VAC' THEN '휴가' WHEN 'BIZTRIP' THEN '출장' WHEN 'OUTSIDE' THEN '외근' WHEN 'HOME' THEN '재택' WHEN 'CLIENT' THEN '상주' ELSE '본사' END AS STATUS_NM, CASE WHEN T.STATUS_CD = 'OFFICE' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS EXTERNAL_YN, T.SCHDL_NM, T.PROFILE_FILE_SN FROM ( SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NM, U.CO_ID, U.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NM, U.JBPS_NM, COALESCE(( SELECT S.SCHDL_SE_CD FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN WHERE R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND S.CO_ID = U.CO_ID AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.SCHDL_SE_CD IN ('VAC', 'BIZTRIP', 'OUTSIDE', 'HOME', 'CLIENT') AND NOW() BETWEEN S.BGNG_DT AND S.END_DT ORDER BY FIELD(S.SCHDL_SE_CD, 'VAC', 'BIZTRIP', 'OUTSIDE', 'HOME', 'CLIENT'), S.BGNG_DT LIMIT 1 ), W.POWK_SE_CD, 'OFFICE') AS STATUS_CD, ( SELECT S.SCHDL_NM FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN WHERE R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND S.CO_ID = U.CO_ID AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.SCHDL_SE_CD IN ('VAC', 'BIZTRIP', 'OUTSIDE', 'HOME', 'CLIENT') AND NOW() BETWEEN S.BGNG_DT AND S.END_DT ORDER BY FIELD(S.SCHDL_SE_CD, 'VAC', 'BIZTRIP', 'OUTSIDE', 'HOME', 'CLIENT'), S.BGNG_DT LIMIT 1 ) AS SCHDL_NM, PF.PROFILE_FILE_SN FROM user_info U LEFT JOIN dept_info D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN work_hstry W ON W.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND W.WORK_YMD = CURDATE() LEFT JOIN ( SELECT F.REF_ID, MAX(F.ATCH_FILE_SN) AS PROFILE_FILE_SN FROM atch_file_info F WHERE F.CO_ID = #{coId} AND F.REF_SE_CD = 'USER' AND F.FILE_SE_CD = 'PROFILE' AND F.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY F.REF_ID ) PF ON PF.REF_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE U.CO_ID = #{coId} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.DEPT_ID IN (SELECT DEPT_ID FROM dept_scope) ) T ORDER BY CASE WHEN T.STATUS_CD = 'OFFICE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, T.USER_NM, T.USER_ID

SELECT U.USER_ID,U.USER_NM,U.CO_ID,U.DEPT_ID,D.DEPT_NM,U.JBPS_NM,#{workYmd} WORK_YMD, DATE_FORMAT(W.GTWK_DT,'%H:%i') GTWK_DT,DATE_FORMAT(W.LVWK_DT,'%H:%i') LVWK_DT, CASE WHEN W.GTWK_DT IS NULL THEN '0' WHEN W.LVWK_DT IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,W.GTWK_DT,W.LVWK_DT) AS CHAR) WHEN #{workYmd}=DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-%d') THEN CAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,W.GTWK_DT,NOW()) AS CHAR) ELSE '0' END WORK_MINUTES, COALESCE((SELECT S.SCHDL_SE_CD FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN=S.SCHDL_SN WHERE R.USER_ID=U.USER_ID AND S.CO_ID=U.CO_ID AND S.USE_YN='Y' AND S.SCHDL_SE_CD IN ('VAC','BIZTRIP','OUTSIDE','HOME','CLIENT') AND #{workYmd} BETWEEN DATE(S.BGNG_DT) AND DATE(S.END_DT) ORDER BY FIELD(S.SCHDL_SE_CD,'VAC','BIZTRIP','OUTSIDE','HOME','CLIENT'),S.BGNG_DT LIMIT 1),CASE WHEN W.GTWK_DT IS NULL THEN 'ABSENT' ELSE COALESCE(W.POWK_SE_CD,'OFFICE') END) STATUS_CD, COALESCE((SELECT IFNULL(C.CD_NM,S.SCHDL_SE_CD) FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN=S.SCHDL_SN LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID='CAL_SCHDL_SE_CD' AND C.CD=S.SCHDL_SE_CD WHERE R.USER_ID=U.USER_ID AND S.CO_ID=U.CO_ID AND S.USE_YN='Y' AND S.SCHDL_SE_CD IN ('VAC','BIZTRIP','OUTSIDE','HOME','CLIENT') AND #{workYmd} BETWEEN DATE(S.BGNG_DT) AND DATE(S.END_DT) ORDER BY FIELD(S.SCHDL_SE_CD,'VAC','BIZTRIP','OUTSIDE','HOME','CLIENT'),S.BGNG_DT LIMIT 1),CASE WHEN W.GTWK_DT IS NULL THEN '미출근' ELSE COALESCE(PC.CD_NM,'본사') END) STATUS_NM, (SELECT S.SCHDL_NM FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN=S.SCHDL_SN WHERE R.USER_ID=U.USER_ID AND S.CO_ID=U.CO_ID AND S.USE_YN='Y' AND S.SCHDL_SE_CD IN ('VAC','BIZTRIP','OUTSIDE','HOME','CLIENT') AND #{workYmd} BETWEEN DATE(S.BGNG_DT) AND DATE(S.END_DT) ORDER BY FIELD(S.SCHDL_SE_CD,'VAC','BIZTRIP','OUTSIDE','HOME','CLIENT'),S.BGNG_DT LIMIT 1) SCHDL_NM FROM user_info U LEFT JOIN dept_info D ON D.DEPT_ID=U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN work_hstry W ON W.USER_ID=U.USER_ID AND W.WORK_YMD=#{workYmd} LEFT JOIN cmn_cd PC ON PC.CD_GROUP_ID='POWK_SE_CD' AND PC.CD=W.POWK_SE_CD AND PC.USE_YN='Y' WHERE U.CO_ID=#{coId} AND U.USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY IFNULL(D.SORT_SEQ,9999),D.DEPT_NM,U.USER_NM,U.USER_ID
SELECT C.CD FROM cmn_cd C WHERE C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'POWK_SE_CD' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.DFLT_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ ASC, C.CD ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WORK_HSTRY ( USER_ID ,WORK_YMD ,GTWK_DT ,POWK_SE_CD ,WORK_RMRK_CN ,REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{userId} ,CURDATE() ,NOW() ,COALESCE(NULLIF(#{powkNm}, ''), ( SELECT C.CD FROM cmn_cd C WHERE C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'POWK_SE_CD' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.DFLT_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ ASC, C.CD ASC LIMIT 1 )) ,#{workRmrkCn} ,NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE WORK_HSTRY SET LVWK_DT = NOW() ,MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND WORK_YMD = CURDATE() AND LVWK_DT IS NULL
